title: Tiger cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M46 29 v5' stroke='#8a4a12' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
